narrator.instruct: Gripping, energetic storyteller telling a true history what-if, brisk and tense, never calm.

crowd.instruct: A man in a street crowd shouting a sudden alarm, loud and frightened.

governor.instruct: An alarmed army general shouting at his driver, sharp and urgent.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A driver took one wrong turn, and stopped right in front of an assassin.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sarajevo, June twenty-eighth, nineteen fourteen. Archduke Franz Ferdinand, heir to the throne, rides in an open car.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That morning, a young man throws a bomb.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It bounces off and blows up under the next car.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The plot seems dead. Another plotter, nineteen-year-old Gavrilo Princip, drifts to a street corner.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Archduke changes plans. He'll visit the wounded in hospital.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The car in front turns down the old route. His driver follows.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The driver brakes to reverse. It stops, a few steps from Princip.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two shots. The Archduke and his wife Sophie are killed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You see, Austria blamed Serbia, and declared war one month later. Russia backed Serbia. Germany backed Austria. France backed Russia.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Within a week, most of Europe was at war. About twenty million would die. Four empires would fall.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now, what if the driver had known? The car speeds past, and Princip probably never gets his shot.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Would war have come anyway? Many historians think so. But not that day, and not from that spark.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that spark came down to one wrong turn.
